title: Abgeruehrter Kugelhopf
description: Prepared with yeast or cake, powdered sugar, and lemon.

ingredients.name: one-half ounce of yeast or one cake compressed yeast
a scant cup of powdered sugar
one-half cup of cleaned and seeded dark raisins

steps: Soak one-half ounce of yeast or one cake compressed yeast in a very little lukewarm milk; add a pinch of salt and one tablespoon of sugar, stir it up smooth and set back of the stove to rise
In the meantime rub a scant cup of butter and a scant cup of powdered sugar to a cream, add gradually the yolks of four eggs, one at a time and add also the grated peel of a lemon
Sift two cups of flour into a bowl, make a depression in the centre, pour in the yeast, one cup of lukewarm milk, and make a light batter of this
Add the creamed butter and eggs and stir until it forms blisters and leaves the bowl clean

Take one-half cup of cleaned and seeded dark raisins and cut up some citron very fine. Dredge flour over them before adding, and if necessary, add more flour to the dough, which should be of the consistency of cup cake batter
Last add the stiffly-beaten whites of the eggs
Place in a well-greased long or round pan with tube in centre; let rise until double in bulk, and bake in moderate oven until browned and thoroughly done

steps: Take one and one-half cups of flour, a pinch of salt sifted into a deep bowl, one cup of lukewarm milk and three-fourths cake of compressed yeast which has been dissolved in a little warm water and sugar

Put another cake on top of one already spread, having cut it with a cutter a little bit smaller than the one used in the first place

description: Prepared with brains, garlic, and vinegar.
steps: Brains must be well washed and cleansed from every particle of blood, and must be skinned, then throw them into clean water again
Cut a good-sized tooth of garlic into a small stewpan, with 2 spoonfuls of the best oil
Let it fry, then take out the garlic
Put in 3 spoonfuls of vinegar, a little salt, pepper, saffron, and a little cayenne, then the brains
Let them cook slowly
Add a teaspoonful of dried winter savory
Boil a few new potatoes, skin them, and put them in a few minutes before it is finished
This dish will only take ¾ an hour to cook
The gravy must not be thickened; a few small meat balls can be put also

title: Brains with Egg Sauce
description: A sauce made with brains, onion, and beef broth.
steps: Prepare the brains the same as the last
Slice in a stewpan some onion, pepper, salt, grated nutmeg, and a cup of beef broth if you have it
Put in the brains with a little marjoram, and a little saffron to colour
Let it cook gently for half an hour
Beat in a basin 2 eggs, the juice of a lemon, a teaspoonful of flour, a little chopped parsley
When it is rubbed smooth, stir it into the saucepan, basting it backwards and forwards to mix the sauce well

title: Brains with Egg Sauce
description: A sauce made with brains, onions, and stock.
steps: Wash brains well, skin
boil fifteen minutes in salt water
slice in stew-pan some onions, salt, pepper, ginger and a cup of stock
Put in the brains with a little marjoram
let it cook gently for one-half hour
Mix yolks of two eggs, juice of a lemon, a teaspoon of flour, a little chopped parsley
when it is rubbed smooth, stir it into saucepan
stir well to prevent curdling

title: Braised Oxtails
description: Prepared with onions, carrots, and tomatoes.
steps: Joint and wash the oxtails.
Slice and brown six onions in pot with oxtails.
When nicely browned add water enough to cover and stew slowly one hour.
Add two carrots, one green pepper, sprig of parsley, one-half cup of tomatoes and six small potatoes, and cook until tender.
Thicken with browned flour.
Cook separately eight lengths of macaroni.
Place cooked macaroni on dish and pour ragout over it and serve hot.

title: Bran Bread
description: A bread preparation made with bran, molasses, and nuts or raisins.
steps: Sift four teaspoons of soda, two teaspoons of salt with four cups of white flour
Add four cups of bran flour and mix well
Add one cup of molasses and four cups of sweet milk
Use chopped nuts or raisins or both as desired
Place in greased pans (four and a half by nine inches)
Bake one hour in a moderate oven

title: Bran Muffins
description: Prepared with bran, molasses, and dates or raisins.

ingredients.name: one and one-half cups of sweet milk
one-half cup of chopped dates or raisins

steps: Sift one-half cup of white flour with one teaspoon of soda
Mix three tablespoons of molasses with one tablespoon of butter
Add two cups of bran, one and one-half cups of sweet milk
Add the flour and one-half teaspoon of salt
Stir all together
One-half cup of chopped dates or raisins may be added if so desired
Bake in muffin-pans in a moderate oven thirty minutes
